nodes.summary: For a real number $t$, its clamp to the unit interval is $\max(0, \min(t, 1))$, regarded as a point of $[0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Clamping to the unit interval

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$ and every real $t$, the extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by clamping satisfies $|f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))| \le \|f\|_\infty$, where $\|f\|_\infty = \sup_{x \in [0, 1]} |f(x)|$ is the sup norm of $f$.
nodes.title: The clamped extension is bounded by the sup norm

nodes.summary: The Volterra operator $V$, $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$, acting on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ with the sup norm, has operator norm $\|V\| \le 1$.
nodes.title: The Volterra operator has norm at most one

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be the Volterra operator $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$ on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ with the sup norm. For every natural number $n$, the operator norm of $V^n$ satisfies $\|V^n\| \le 1/n!$.
nodes.title: Factorial bound for powers of the Volterra operator

nodes.summary: The Volterra operator $V$, $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$, on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ is not a unit in the algebra of bounded linear operators on that space.
nodes.title: The Volterra operator is not invertible

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be the Volterra operator $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$ on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$. For every natural number $n$, every such function $f$ and every $x \in [0, 1]$, $|(V^n f)(x)| \le \frac{x^n}{n!} \|f\|_\infty$, where $\|f\|_\infty$ is the sup norm of $f$.
nodes.title: Pointwise factorial bound for powers of the Volterra operator

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be the Volterra operator $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$ on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$. Its spectral radius over the real scalars, the supremum of $|z|$ over real $z$ in the spectrum of $V$, is $0$.
nodes.title: The spectral radius of the Volterra operator is zero

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$ and every real $t$ with $0 \le t \le 1$, the extension $s \mapsto f(\max(0, \min(s, 1)))$ of $f$ to $\mathbb{R}$ takes the value $f(t)$ at $t$.
nodes.title: The clamped extension agrees with the original function on the unit interval

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$, its extension $t \mapsto f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by clamping is continuous on $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: The clamped extension is continuous

nodes.summary: For a bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$, its extension to $\mathbb{R}$ is the function $t \mapsto f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))$.
nodes.title: Extension by clamping

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$, the Volterra linear map $V$ satisfies $\|Vf\| \le 1 \cdot \|f\|$, where $\|\cdot\|$ is the sup norm.
nodes.title: Sup-norm bound for the Volterra linear map

nodes.summary: The real-linear map $V$ on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ given by $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$ for $x \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: The Volterra operator as a linear map

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$, the Volterra operator $V$ satisfies $(Vf)(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: Volterra integrals vanish at the left endpoint

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$ and every $x \in [0, 1]$, the Volterra operator $V$ satisfies $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x \tilde f(t)\,dt$, where $\tilde f(t) = f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))$ is the extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by clamping the argument into $[0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Evaluation formula for the Volterra operator

nodes.summary: For every nonzero real $z$, $z$ lies in the real resolvent set of the Volterra operator $V$: the bounded operator $z - V$ is invertible.
nodes.title: Nonzero reals lie in the resolvent set of the Volterra operator

nodes.summary: The spectrum of the Volterra operator is `{0}`.
nodes.title: The spectrum of the Volterra operator is `{0}`

nodes.summary: The bounded real-linear operator $V$ on the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ (equivalently $C([0, 1], \mathbb{R})$ with the sup norm) given by $(Vf)(x) = \int_0^x f(t)\,dt$ for $x \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: The Volterra operator

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$, the function $x \mapsto \int_0^x \tilde f(t)\,dt$ on $[0, 1]$ is continuous, where $\tilde f(t) = f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))$ is the extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by clamping the argument into $[0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Continuity of the Volterra primitive

nodes.summary: For every bounded continuous real function $f$ on $[0, 1]$ and every $x \in [0, 1]$, $\left|\int_0^x \tilde f(t)\,dt\right| \le \|f\|$, where $\|f\|$ is the sup norm of $f$ and $\tilde f(t) = f(\max(0, \min(t, 1)))$ is the extension of $f$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by clamping the argument into $[0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Sup-norm bound for the Volterra primitive

nodes.summary: The space on which the Volterra operator acts is the space of bounded continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$, with the sup norm.
nodes.title: The domain of the Volterra operator

nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $V$ be the operators on functions $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ given by $(Xg)(y) = y \, g(y)$ and $(Vg)(y) = \int_0^y g(t) \, dt$, write $(XV)^n$ and $V^m$ for iterated composition, and let $a(m, k)$ be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the Bessel polynomial $y_m$. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, every continuous function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and every real number $x$,
nodes.title: Expansion of $(XV)^n$ in Bessel numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
